images.title: 多镜头拆解
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, editorial product feature illustration.
Create a NEW polished vertical 9:16 portrait raster illustration, 900x1600 composition, for a narrow image card on the AI Creative Lab landing page. This card must VISUALLY explain automatic multi-shot video breakdown, rather than being a plain lifestyle photo. It is a crisp flat front-facing analysis board, no browser, no device, no perspective, no exterior margin or rounded outer mockup.
Consistent series visual language: charcoal-black #101317 canvas, restrained gray dividers, off-white typography, very restrained mint green #b7e4ce analysis accents. Realistic warm sunlit cinematic video stills provide the main color. All content inside safe 36px margins. Large legible typography and pictures, designed to remain understandable at 280px wide. No tiny decorative prose.
The reference-video story across the entire illustration is ONE morning coffee routine: a young East Asian woman with loosely tied black hair and an ivory linen shirt in a sunlit beige kitchen; a transparent ribbed glass of iced coffee, silver gooseneck kettle, dark coffee grounds, pale oak worktop. Same person, glass and kitchen across shots, beautiful natural film photography, no brand logos.
Card topic: MULTI-SHOT BREAKDOWN.
At top a clear short white Chinese title verbatim "多镜头拆解". Under it a subtle small line "00:00 — 00:18".
The main body is FOUR spacious horizontal scene rows stacked vertically. Every row contains a fairly large cinematic 16:9 shot on the left 65% of the row and a clean little timing column on the right. Distinct shots: 1 extreme close-up of coffee grounds and grinder; 2 medium shot of the woman preparing coffee at the counter; 3 macro close-up of the silver kettle pouring into the ribbed glass; 4 close shot of her holding the finished iced coffee in sunlight. Right-side exact labels: "SHOT 01", "SHOT 02", "SHOT 03", "SHOT 04" with clear short durations "2.4s", "4.1s", "3.2s", "3.8s". Rows separated by thin gray lines, not heavy cards.
Bottom 20% is a real-looking video scene-detection timeline: a horizontal strip of the four thumbnails, mint vertical cut markers aligned with shot boundaries, a clean audio waveform, one slender white playhead. Bottom caption exact "镜头边界 · 自动切分".
Professional serious creative analysis interface, highly polished, no fake metrics or random charts, no colorful neon UI, no redundant pills. Big visual emphasis on different SHOTS and detected EDIT CUTS. Accurately render all specified text, no additional slogans.

Keep the same dark-charcoal analysis-board style, off-white Chinese typography, mint analytical annotations, same cinematic warm kitchen, same young East Asian woman in an ivory linen shirt, same silver gooseneck kettle and ribbed coffee glass. Create a DIFFERENT panel focused on CAMERA LANGUAGE; do not repeat the reference's stacked shot-list layout.
Header exact large white "镜头语言", smaller neutral "SHOT 03".
Main center 60% of canvas: a beautiful large realistic close-up movie still showing the silver gooseneck kettle pouring a narrow stream into a clear ribbed glass of dark iced coffee on pale oak. Strong foreground-background depth and warm window backlight. Low angle, cup dominates near foreground. Overlay a very thin mint 3x3 composition grid on this ONE photo, four understated framing corners, a small focus box on the water stream. One clear mint forward arrow from the near foreground toward the glass conveys slow camera push-in, and a clean thin curved arc at the side conveys viewing angle. Below the photo, three generously spaced readable analysis rows, with simple neutral line glyphs at left:
"景别" / "特写"
"机位" / "低角度"
"运镜" / "慢推"

Sophisticated restrained product-design aesthetic, large legible short text, charcoal #101317 background, warm photographic tones, mint #b7e4ce annotations only, no neon effects, no stock lifestyle poster, no tiny paragraphs, no invented metrics. a restrained warm amber box around ONLY the glass in her hand with exact label "产品";
a soft cool-blue box around ONLY the silver kettle with exact label "道具".

Under it a single row of three separated cutout-like photographic thumbnails against dark neutral backgrounds: the same woman, the isolated ribbed coffee glass, and the silver kettle. Bottom area: two small frames from two different coffee-video shots connected with a simple mint line; a mint outline links the same woman's silhouette across the frames. Footer caption exact "同一主体 · 跨镜头关联".
